summary: Iteration 340 review of the A2P 10DLC client onboarding add-on. Backend: wrote 29 new pytest cases (tests/test_compliance_iter340.py) covering settings surface, store record shape (form_url, portout_url, account_number 8-char, events, next_action, no token leakage), send-form + remind + notification creation, public form GET/PUT/submit + bad-token 404, pre-flight with fake vs. real (twilio.com) URLs, stale-preflight-blocks-submit, submit gate + review reviewed/reopen/invalid, full Twilio dry-run lifecycle + twilio_status events, numbers view + release/status 400s, portout send + public port-out packet (Twilio, Inc. + 6 steps + bad-token 404), auto-invite at signup with Mongo cleanup. Combined with 26 helper tests (test_compliance_onboarding, test_twilio_compliance, test_compliance_review_iter339) => 55/55 pass in 35s. Frontend: verified all requested testIDs render on /a2p-onboarding/{token}, /port-out/{token}, /admin/compliance and /admin/compliance/{QA} (login + localStorage token + history.pushState). Public form CNAM uppercases 'qa motors' -> 'QA MOTORS' automatically, Save shows 'Saved 3:12 PM' timestamp. Port-out page authorized_name reads 'Twilio, Inc.'; bad token shows portout-error. Admin overview has 5 stat cards, settings toggle with all inputs incl. compliance-auto-invite and compliance-digest, filter chips all|client|team|twilio|bad|done. Store page: onboarding-card + pill, send-form modal chips, preflight-card with score/verdict/counts and review buttons, numbers-exit-toggle opens portout-panel with prefilled last packet timestamp, compliance-submit-hint shows '3 blockers in pre-flight (super admin can force)'.

minor.issue: Original code used rp.setdefault('first_name', parts[0]) but tc.defaults() always seeds rep with first_name='' so setdefault never fires; the rep first_name/last_name stayed empty on new signups. Fixed in place with truthy guards (if not rp.get('first_name'): ...). Verified with new integration test test_signup_creates_store_and_invites.

action_items: Optional: Consider mapping the 'compliance' notification type in routers/notifications_center.py verb table so team notifications surface in the in-app feed UI (they exist in db.notifications but the notification-center response filters them out). Currently the store's Events tab + email cover the gap.
critical_code_review_comments: compliance_onboarding.auto_invite (~L253): rp.setdefault on keys that tc.defaults() pre-seeds with '' never overwrites — fixed in this iteration for first_name / last_name using truthy guards to match the pattern already used for email/phone.

compliance.py POST /{storeId}/submit gate: pre-flight staleness message vs. blockers vs. review vs. force flow is clear; super_admin ?force=true correctly bypasses only the gate, downstream tc.start still 400s on missing required fields (verified).
compliance_onboarding.numbers_view: correctly hides the raw token from responses (only exposes portout_url) — good; store record GET also strips tokens from record.onboarding/portout (verified).

compliance_onboarding.run_reminders: cadence 2/5/9 -> flagged (stalled) verified by test_compliance_onboarding helper tests; the >=20h de-dup guard prevents double-firing when the scheduler ticks twice in one day.

compliance_preflight: fake domain (qamotors.example) correctly produces 3 blockers (website/privacy/terms); switching to twilio.com pages drops them off block. verdict/label/score fields all populated as documented.

rca of the issue: auto_invite rep pre-fill: services/compliance_onboarding.auto_invite used dict.setdefault('first_name', parts[0]) but the record is initialized by services/twilio_compliance.defaults() with rep={'first_name': '', 'last_name': '', ...}. Because the key exists with an empty string, setdefault is a no-op and the signup contact name never propagates. Fix: guard with `if not rp.get('first_name'): rp['first_name'] = parts[0]` (matches the pattern already used a few lines below for rp.email/rp.phone). Test test_signup_creates_store_and_invites now asserts rep.first_name == 'Signup' after POST /api/setup-wizard/new-account.
